meta.description: IQ2GQ Hub - matched syndicate EPL/English football picks against real-world match results and bookmaker odds
meta.source_odds_data: football-data.co.uk. Premier League (E0) season files 2009/10-2026/27, plus Championship (E1) season files 2017/18-2026/27.
meta.matching_method: Team name canonicalisation (Manchester City/United, West Ham United, Wolverhampton Wanderers -> Wolves, Stoke City, Derby County -> Derby) + nearest-date match within +/-10 days of the recorded pick date, searched across combined Premier League + Championship data. 'division' field on each record (E0/E1) shows which tier the matched game was actually played in. Market odds field uses Bet365 (B365H/B365A) as the reference bookmaker price.
meta.scope_note: Championship coverage currently only goes back to 2017/18. 6 rows remain unmatched because the pick predates that (2014/15-2016/17 seasons): Norwich x2, Portsmouth, Newcastle x2, Cambridge, Millwall. Not errors - just outside current data coverage, resolvable if earlier Championship season files are added later.
meta.excluded_rows_note: 2 rows excluded for Sport field mistagging (Bayern Munich, Real Madrid). 3 rows excluded as genuinely out of scope even with Championship data added: Notts County (League Two in 2018), Milton Keynes Dons (League One in 2019), and one unclear club name ('Brentworth') that doesn't match any real Premier League or Championship club.
meta.draw_handling_note: For H2H bet validation, a drawn match correctly counts as a loss (consistent with standard match-odds betting), not an automatic discrepancy.
